raw_remove_splitter.history_api_note: Raw Shape.removeSplitter carries both sources inside a composite mapped name, but getElementHistory only returns one source tag and opaque composite text. Native Part::Refine drops this map. A custom adapter/parser would need separately proven complete and persistent creator semantics.

history_api_options.object_docstring:
getElementHistory(name,recursive=True,sameType=False,showName=False) - returns the element mapped name history

name: mapped element name belonging to this shape
recursive: if True, then track back the history through other objects till the origin
sameType: if True, then stop trace back when element type changes
showName: if False, return the owner object, or else return a tuple of object name and label

If not recursive, then return tuple(sourceObject, sourceElementName, [intermediateNames...]),
otherwise return a list of tuple.
history_api_options.shape_docstring:
getElementHistory(name) - returns the element mapped name history

name: mapped element name belonging to this shape

Returns tuple(sourceShapeTag, sourceName, [intermediateNames...]),
or None if no history.

primary_naming_algorithm_source.interpretation: The algorithm author documents multi-source names in parentheses and first-source linear getElementHistory traversal. Disabling the document hasher exposes names for parsing. This supports a potential custom provenance adapter; it does not establish this runtime's complete creator query behavior across every requested operation.

checks_passed: Native Pad and Pocket expose element maps and history
Current feature appears on untouched inherited face history
Cut split face multiplicity is visible through source histories
Refined MultiFuse loses merged top face's second creator
Refined MultiFuse leaves invalid Face7..Face10 map indexes
Fresh MultiFuse configured Refine=True before first build has the same failure
Native Part::Refine exposes no element map
Raw Shape.removeSplitter preserves composite mapped names but not full history traversal
All eight documented object history flag combinations tested; none traverses both merged creators
UseHasher=False does not repair native MultiFuse refinement maps
Unhashed raw removeSplitter composite mapped name retains both merged source IDs
Native history loss and wrong creator correspondence persist after FCStd reopen and fresh rebuild
conclusion: getElementHistory membership is not qCreatedBy; all result objects occur on inherited-face history. Split source multiplicity is available, but refined native MultiFuse exposes incomplete and incorrectly indexed history for merged faces. Raw removeSplitter names retain both sources; the author's documented grammar and UseHasher=False offer a custom parser route. No exact all-creators query adapter is demonstrated by this spike.
